renderSettings.tempo: Retain each recording's chosen audition tempo through MIDI-event timing; do not impose the Burgmuller tempo on other pieces or stretch rendered audio

preferredPiano.verification: Confirm actual reverb in the output using a wet/dry comparison. Earlier Salamander A/B renders were effectively identical because no MIDI reverb send reached the effect. additionalStrings.feedback: After the full-piece C2 harmony correction, the maintainer applauds and selects the YDP piano with and without strings, each at original and sleep tempo, for publication. additionalStrings.audition: Burgmuller op. 109 No. 7: piano B with newly arranged held violin, viola and cello accompaniment; full-piece revision C2

revision.method: Review the full piano transcription's accompaniment notes and attacks, including dominant upper harmonies over tonic bass pedals and individual final-cadence changes. Do not infer an unchanged chord from a sustained bass alone. Gate each string note and its room response to silence before incompatible harmonic changes, retaining common tones only across compatible regions.
revision.validation: 37 full-piece harmonic regions, 127 compatible string-note/region intersections, paired MIDI events, full MP3 decode, matched loudness, peak headroom, quiet ending and matching local Nextcloud copies. This is structural verification against estimated piano notes, not a claim of error-free transcription or listening approval.

publication.note: Published MP3 decoded samples retain the selected auditions; ID3 metadata is updated for publication. The manifest records published-byte hashes separately from original audition hashes. Original-tempo renders use the same selected voice and arrangement without separate listening feedback.
publication.delivery: Commit-pinned Raw GitHub files; no music releases or release ZIPs

pianoPreset.admissionBoundary: Piano-voice preference is not approval to replace any catalog recording or to promote an arrangement. Retain each specific source performance's recording license, attribution, modification disclosure and original files. Keep estimated original MIDI velocities separately from render-only softening. Complete recording-specific rights, audio-delivery, suitability and listening checks for each resulting recording before promotion.

recommendedBerceuseStyle.description: Follow the successful Burgmuller preparation for future Berceuse pieces: warm instrumental YDP piano B, expressive estimated dynamics and overlapping notes with sustain, restrained verified room ambience, and a separately auditioned chamber-string variation for background fullness.
recommendedBerceuseStyle.piano: Use preferredPiano.renderSettings as defaults; soften velocities only for rendering, preserve raw source events. No chorus, compressor or limiter.
recommendedBerceuseStyle.strings: Quiet violin, viola and cello; reference RMS 11 dB below piano. Check the full piece, including harmonies above a sustained bass and rapid cadences. Align attacks and complete wet/dry releases; tie only compatible common tones.
recommendedBerceuseStyle.tempoAndEnding: Adjust MIDI-event timing before synthesis, retain each chosen performance tempo and an appropriately chosen sleep tempo; preserve musical decay and remove only an inaudible tail.
recommendedBerceuseStyle.review: Match listening levels and audition every new accompaniment across the whole work. The style recommendation is not automatic arrangement, rights or catalog approval.
